name: Multivitamin & mineral liquid
summary: 1 mL · Seven vitamins, zinc and iodine · 200 mg sugar · Water-base working estimate
contents:
Item	Quantity	Unit
FINISHED BATCH	1	mL
Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid)	4	mg
Vitamin B3 (Nicotinamide)	4	mg
Vitamin B5 (D-Panthenol)	1.5	mg
Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin sodium phosphate)	400	ug
Vitamin B1 (Thiamine hydrochloride)	300	ug
Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine hydrochloride)	200	ug
Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)	0.4	ug
Zinc (as Zinc sulfate)	3	mg
Iodine (as potassium iodide)	45	ug
SUGAR	200	mg
NEPAZENE	1	mg
NEPASOL	.4	mg
BRONOPAL	.1	mg
SOD BENZ	3	mg
BENZOIC ACID	1	mg
